function.name: Hotels_2_BookHouse

I don’t have real‑time weather data, but I can give you a quick snapshot of what Hanoi usually looks like around this time of year.

| Month | Typical High (°C) | Typical Low (°C) | Precipitation | Notes |
|-------|-------------------|------------------|---------------|-------|
| Jan   | 18–20             | 7–9              | 30 mm         | Cool, dry |
| Feb   | 20–22             | 8–10             | 40 mm         | Still cool |
| Mar   | 23–26             | 12–14            | 70 mm         | Warm, more rain |
| Apr   | 27–30             | 15–17            | 120 mm        | Hot, rainy |
| May   | 29–32             | 18–20            | 200 mm        | Peak rainy season |
| Jun   | 28–31             | 19–21            | 250 mm        | Very wet |
| Jul   | 27–30             | 19–22            | 260 mm        | Monsoon |
| Aug   | 27–30             | 19–22            | 260 mm        | Monsoon |
| Sep   | 26–29             | 18–21            | 210 mm        | Drier |
| Oct   | 24–27             | 16–19            | 140 mm        | Cooler, less rain |
| Nov   | 21–24             | 13–16            | 80 mm         | Dry, mild |
| Dec   | 18–20             | 8–10             | 30 mm         | Cool, dry |
